Construct Name: Perceptions of artificial intelligence in mathematics education (ad hoc 9-item questionnaire; three factors, 5/2/2 items)
Context Text: 853 university students in Melilla, Ceuta and Granada (Spain); an ad hoc questionnaire on the use and perception of AI as a tool for learning mathematics and solving mathematical problems, validated by an expert panel
Reason: Age Range derived from cov_age rather than judged (850 usable values, 30 distinct, 17-55): 34 respondents are 17, which is 4.0% and clears the 2% floor, so both sides of 18 are present and it is Mixed, not the Adult (18+) that 'university students' would suggest. Child Age is Adolescent (12-18y) alone, the only band holding anyone. Item text available? Yes: the administered Spanish stems ARE the spreadsheet's column headers. Construct type Opinion/attitude alone -- eight of the nine items ask about perceived usefulness, reliability and trust; only 'I ask AI to create math problems for me to practice' reports an act, which is not enough to make the table Behavioral. Frame General/non-specific: recruitment is described and the study imposes no restriction on top of the university setting, and it claims no representativeness.
